about_the_game:
NOT EASY, NOT SORRY!

A fully offline, true indie, solo-developed mid-core 2.5D looter-shooter with hand-drawn visuals and fast-paced combat.

It’s hard by design—you WILL get better.

Skill-based gameplay combines decision making and gradual progression.

A challenging yet fair action game where success depends on skill and strategy, not luck alone. Master mechanics, leverage upgrades, and adapt to survive.

Key Features:

  • A Unique Universe – A beautifully hand-drawn world filled with distinct creatures, enemies, and immersive environments.

  • 3 Distinct Biomes – Each with unique enemies, traps, surroundings, and interactive encounters.

  • Challenging Boss Fights – Face 9 Mini Bosses, 3 Major Bosses, and a Final Boss, each with unique mechanics.

  • Wearable Items & Weapons – Customize your loadout with gear that provides unique perks and playstyles.

  • Upgradeable Village – Unlock 27 permanent upgrades to enhance abilities and refine your strategy.

  • 120+ Perks – A deep perk system with tree-like progression for limitless builds and replayability.

  • Unique enemies — Every one with it unique style, attacks and skills.

Gameplay Focus:

  • Skill-Oriented Progression – No artificial difficulty—your own skill and strategy determine success.

  • Tough Yet Fair – Charming visuals, brutal challenge. You earn every victory.

Final Touches:

  • Fully offline!

  • No F2P Mechanics. – A pure, premium experience.

Shoot’n’Shell isn’t just a game—it’s a test of mastery in a visually stunning, deceptively tough world.

Ready to prove yourself?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: glibc 2.17+, 32/64-bit
  • Processor: Quad Core 3GHz+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
